_doc: Single source of truth for the Rio geographic pipeline. See Docs/Map/CoordinateSystem.md.

crs.geographic_note: SIRGAS 2000 geographic. OSM/WGS84 (EPSG:4326) inputs differ from SIRGAS 2000 by < 1 m and are transformed through pyproj.
crs.projected_note: SIRGAS 2000 / UTM zone 23S. Metric, official Brazilian CRS, used by Rio de Janeiro municipal data (IPP / Data.Rio).
crs.vertical: EGM2008 orthometric height (metres above mean sea level), as delivered by Copernicus DEM

unreal._doc: SOURCE-scale (1:1) world frame. The compressed playable map uses its own frame defined by the compression graph, NOT this one.
unreal.axis_mapping: UE +X = East, UE +Y = South (-North), UE +Z = Up. Matches the GeoReferencing plugin's default ENU-to-Unreal convention.

full.description: Full target region: Centro/Gamboa/Lapa/Santa Teresa, Sao Cristovao/Maracana, Flamengo/Botafogo/Urca, Copacabana/Leme, Ipanema/Leblon, Lagoa, Corcovado, Vidigal.

test_leblon_vidigal.description: Phase 4 test: west Leblon, start of Av. Niemeyer, entrance to Vidigal and the lower part of Av. Pres. Joao Goulart.

test_leblon_arpoador.description: Hero area 1 test: the beach from Mirante do Leblon to Pedra do Arpoador, back to the south shore of Lagoa (Delfim Moreira, Vieira Souto, Ataulfo de Paiva / Visconde de Piraja, Jardim de Alah).

roads._doc: Realistic widths in metres (carriageway, kerb to kerb). OSM 'width' wins, then 'lanes' x lane_width + extra, then class default.

max_grade._doc: rise/run; null = follow terrain. Vidigal/Santa Teresa streets genuinely reach ~25-30%.

buildings._doc: Placeholder heights. OSM height / building:levels win; otherwise deterministic defaults keyed on OSM id.

beach._doc: Hero beach blockout (scripts/build_beach.py). Everything is generated from the beachfront road centreline plus a measured cross-section profile, so the same profile can be re-applied to the compressed map's centreline. Offsets are metres seaward from the road centreline.
